title.en: An Act Authorizing the Sale of the Land Occupied By San Lazaro Hospital and the Improvements thereon, Under Certain Conditions, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The Governor-General is hereby authorized to sell or exchange, as may be in the public interest,
the land occupied by San Lazaro Hospital, in the City of Manila, and the improvements thereon, provided the
proceeds of the sale or exchange are set aside for the construction of a new public hospital in the City of
Manila or any of the adjacent towns, in accordance with the requirements of modern sanitation, for the care,
treatment, and welfare of the lepers of the Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1925.
